summary.headline: Teucer on Zodiac Decans
summary.text: Teucer the Babylonian’s astrological account of the three decans of each zodiac sign, beginning with Aries and continuing through Scorpio, describing their effects on wealth, marriage, health, danger, status, children, and old age. It explains that each sign has three decans of ten degrees and assigns the Sun’s influences to each decan.
